title: A Cold non-terminal test-run card for an unchanged indexed run is never revisited and blocks its run's compaction indefinitely
outcome: A test-run card that is not terminal, whose run is still indexed and unchanged (for example a card that was Cold, outside the session's in-memory window, when its run turned terminal), is eventually revisited and corrected, so it no longer keeps its run out of compaction forever.
acceptance: A focused test shows that a card left non-terminal while Cold during the pass that made its indexed run terminal is corrected on a later rescan once it is resident again, and that the run then becomes compaction-eligible, without any change to the run's artifacts.
